newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Budapest maize futures mixed, wheat mostly higher.
newsitem.headline: Budapest maize futures mixed, wheat mostly higher.

text.p: Maize ended mixed on the Budapest Commodities Exchange (BCE) on Thursday in above-average trade, while milling wheat saw mostly gains, traders said.
"Milling wheat showed a strengthening tendency all round," said Sandor Torok of Agrokont Brokerhaz. "This year's maize showed minimal change while next year's saw much stronger rises."
Milling wheat contracts maturing in December rose 40 after Wednesday's fall to end at 27,850, while May 1997 was unchanged. August 1997 contracts, however, rose 350 forints to 22,000.
Maize futures prices were unchanged for December, up 70 to 100 forints for March, May and July 1997, but down 150 forints for November and 50 for December 1997.
Total turnover for the grain section was 628 million forints, or 2,761 lots, of which 1,139 were maize and 211 were milling wheat contracts.
Lot size is 20,000 kg for all contracts.
